verdict.rationale: Highnote's docs confirm a configurable webhook/events system (highnote-docs-12,13), a unified transaction-level ledger (highnote-docs-3,19), programmatic refund/capture across the payment lifecycle (highnote-docs-20), and a dedicated disputes/chargeback process (highnote-docs-10), which together support post-auth events flowing to a developer's own ledger. However, the evidence never explicitly enumerates clearing/reversal/chargeback as distinct webhook event types or confirms stable transaction identifiers tying these events together across the lifecycle. Missing for 10: explicit webhook event-type list showing clearings/reversals/chargebacks, and documentation of a stable transaction ID field used consistently across auth→settlement→dispute events.
